the current approaches to Word Sense Disambiguatioin are not enough for a complete understanding of natural language, and that we should move towards a more cognitive and distributed way of dealing with the problem of understanding natural language, by focusing on the meaning of the whole sentence, and not just on the meaning of single terms.
